name: Deskdrop
tagline: A smart keyboard powered by your own AI models
description:
Deskdrop is an Android keyboard that connects to AI models to help you write, whether that's a model running locally on your own device through tools like Ollama and Whisper, or a cloud service like Gemini or Groq.

It's aimed at people who want AI-assisted typing while staying in control of where their data goes and which models they use.
